examples.zh: 案例披露了一项「赊购取得的资产」，报告期结束时，公司仍未付清该资产的款项。

examples.en: We found the asset acquired on credit in the equipment note before tracing its later cash payment.
examples.zh: 我们先在设备附注里找到了这项「赊购取得的资产」，再追溯其后续付款。

collocations: disclose an asset acquired on credit
record an asset acquired on credit
pay for an asset acquired on credit

words.zhGloss: 非现金交易的补充披露
words.enDefinition: supporting information about material investing or financing transactions that do not involve cash flows and are excluded from cash flow totals
acceptedZhAnswers: 非现金交易的补充披露

examples.en: The supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions described how the company exchanged its shares for production machinery.
examples.zh: 「非现金交易的补充披露」说明了公司如何用股份换取生产机器。

examples.en: Our example included a supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions with the initial recognition of a lease liability.
examples.zh: 我们的示例采用「非现金交易的补充披露」，说明某项租赁负债的初始确认。

collocations: provide a supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions
review the supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions
read the supplemental disclosure of non-cash transactions

words.zhGloss: 筹资活动产生的负债调节表
words.enDefinition: a schedule connecting beginning and ending balances of financing-related liabilities through cash and non-cash movements
acceptedZhAnswers: 筹资活动产生的负债调节表

examples.en: The financing liabilities reconciliation showed how new leases and principal repayments affected the company's reported obligations.
examples.zh: 「筹资活动产生的负债调节表」说明了新增租赁及偿还本金如何影响公司所列债务。

examples.en: We matched the financing liabilities reconciliation to the borrowing amounts in the balance sheet and related notes.
examples.zh: 我们把「筹资活动产生的负债调节表」与资产负债表及相关附注的借款金额核对。

collocations: prepare a financing liabilities reconciliation
publish a financing liabilities reconciliation
review the financing liabilities reconciliation

words.expression: changes in liabilities from financing activities
words.lemma: changes in liabilities from financing activities
words.zhGloss: 筹资活动产生的负债的变动
words.enDefinition: movements in liabilities whose related cash flows have been or will be classified as financing cash flows
acceptedZhAnswers: 筹资活动产生的负债的变动
acceptedEnVariants: changes in liabilities from financing activities

examples.en: The note explained changes in liabilities from financing activities after the company obtained a new equipment lease.
examples.zh: 公司签订新的设备租约后，附注解释了「筹资活动产生的负债的变动」。

examples.en: We separated changes in liabilities from financing activities from the increase in payables for normal purchases.
examples.zh: 我们将「筹资活动产生的负债的变动」与日常采购形成的应付款增加额分开。

collocations: disclose changes in liabilities from financing activities
reconcile changes in liabilities from financing activities
explain changes in liabilities from financing activities

words.zhGloss: 筹资活动产生的负债的现金变动
words.enDefinition: movements in financing-related liabilities resulting from receipts or payments of cash
acceptedZhAnswers: 筹资活动产生的负债的现金变动

examples.en: We tracked cash changes in financing liabilities by matching loan drawdowns and principal repayments to the bank records.
examples.zh: 我们将贷款提款和本金偿还与银行记录相核对，据此追踪「筹资活动产生的负债的现金变动」。

examples.en: The schedule compared cash changes in financing liabilities with the related financing flows reported for the period.
examples.zh: 附表比较了「筹资活动产生的负债的现金变动」与本期报告的相关筹资现金流。

collocations: identify cash changes in financing liabilities
reconcile cash changes in financing liabilities
disclose cash changes in financing liabilities

words.zhGloss: 筹资活动产生的负债的非现金变动
words.enDefinition: movements in financing-related liabilities arising without payments or receipts, such as changes caused by exchange rates
acceptedZhAnswers: 筹资活动产生的负债的非现金变动

examples.en: Some non-cash changes in financing liabilities reflected foreign currency remeasurement at the end of the reporting period.
examples.zh: 部分「筹资活动产生的负债的非现金变动」来自报告期末的外币重新计量。

examples.en: We distinguished non-cash changes in financing liabilities from repayments that reduced the same balances during the year.
examples.zh: 我们将「筹资活动产生的负债的非现金变动」与本年使同一余额减少的还款区分开。

collocations: identify non-cash changes in financing liabilities
disclose non-cash changes in financing liabilities
explain non-cash changes in financing liabilities

words.enDefinition: lease payment obligations recognised for leases beginning during the reporting period

examples.en: The accountant identified new lease liabilities when the company's rented delivery vehicles first became available for use.
examples.zh: 公司所租的送货车首次可供使用时，会计确认了「新增租赁负债」。

examples.en: The practice schedule showed the recognition of new lease liabilities separately from cash paid against existing balances.
examples.zh: 练习附表把「新增租赁负债」的确认与为偿还现有负债付出的现金分开列报。

collocations: recognise new lease liabilities
disclose new lease liabilities
calculate new lease liabilities

words.enDefinition: cash payments for costs directly associated with obtaining debt financing, such as fees for issuing bonds

examples.en: The financing schedule separately identified debt issue costs paid when the company sold its new bonds.
examples.zh: 公司发行新债券时，筹资附表单列了「支付的债务发行费用」。

examples.en: We checked whether the cash amount for debt issue costs paid matched invoices settled during the period.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「支付的债务发行费用」金额是否与本期付清的发票相符。

collocations: report debt issue costs paid
disclose debt issue costs paid
reconcile debt issue costs paid

words.expression: fair value changes in financing liabilities
words.lemma: fair value changes in financing liabilities
words.zhGloss: 筹资活动产生的负债的公允价值变动
words.enDefinition: movements arising when relevant financing-related obligations are remeasured at fair value
acceptedZhAnswers: 筹资活动产生的负债的公允价值变动
acceptedEnVariants: fair value changes in financing liabilities

examples.en: The note identified fair value changes in financing liabilities that did not involve a payment during the year.
examples.zh: 附注列出了本年没有发生付款的「筹资活动产生的负债的公允价值变动」。

examples.en: We traced fair value changes in financing liabilities to the line for remeasurement in the fictional company's schedule.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构公司的附表中找到了与「筹资活动产生的负债的公允价值变动」对应的重新计量项目。

collocations: disclose fair value changes in financing liabilities
analyse fair value changes in financing liabilities
reconcile fair value changes in financing liabilities

words.enDefinition: an arrangement in which a finance provider offers to settle supplier invoices and the buyer repays the provider

examples.en: The supplier finance arrangement let participating suppliers receive payments sooner while the buyer paid the provider later.
examples.zh: 通过「供应商融资安排」，参与的供应商可以提前收款，买方以后再向融资方支付。

examples.en: The note explained the payment terms of a supplier finance arrangement used by the company during the year.
examples.zh: 附注解释了公司本年采用的一项「供应商融资安排」的付款条件。

collocations: enter into a supplier finance arrangement
disclose a supplier finance arrangement
describe a supplier finance arrangement

words.enDefinition: reporting information about supplier finance, such as payment terms, involved liabilities and associated liquidity risks

examples.en: The IAS 7 supplier finance disclosure identified outstanding liabilities for invoices the provider had already paid.
examples.zh: IAS 7 的「供应商融资披露」列出了融资方已向供应商付款、买方仍未清偿的相应负债。

examples.en: We reviewed the supplier finance disclosure to find the range of payment dates for liabilities in the arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们查阅了「供应商融资披露」，了解安排内负债的付款日期范围。

collocations: prepare a supplier finance disclosure
review a supplier finance disclosure
expand a supplier finance disclosure

words.enDefinition: moving an amount out of or into a trade payable presentation category when its circumstances support a different classification

examples.en: The report explained a trade payable reclassification after the company assessed the terms of its financing arrangement.
examples.zh: 公司评估其融资安排的条件后，报告说明了一项「应付账款重分类」。

examples.en: We checked whether the trade payable reclassification reflected new terms or a correction of the earlier presentation.
examples.zh: 我们核查了「应付账款重分类」反映了新条款，还是对先前列报的更正。

collocations: explain a trade payable reclassification
report a trade payable reclassification
review a trade payable reclassification

words.enDefinition: the interval from the earliest to the latest dates or time limits at which specified payments are due

examples.en: The note compared the payment due date range under the arrangement with that for similar ordinary trade payables.
examples.zh: 附注比较了安排内和类似普通应付账款的「付款到期日范围」。

examples.en: Readers asked for the payment due date range to see when those invoices would have to be settled.
examples.zh: 读者要求查看「付款到期日范围」，以了解这些发票何时必须结清。

collocations: disclose a payment due date range
explain the payment due date range
compare the payment due date range

words.enDefinition: a significant exposure to difficulty meeting payments that is concentrated in a common counterparty or other shared source

examples.en: Depending on one finance provider created a liquidity risk concentration in the example used during our course.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，依赖单一融资方造成了「流动性风险集中」。

examples.en: The note on liquidity risk concentration explained how much of the company's supplier financing involved one bank.
examples.zh: 「流动性风险集中」附注说明了公司有多少供应商融资涉及同一家银行。

collocations: disclose a liquidity risk concentration
identify a liquidity risk concentration
assess liquidity risk concentration

words.expression: carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities
words.lemma: carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities
words.zhGloss: 供应商融资负债的账面金额
words.enDefinition: the amount at which liabilities included in a supplier finance arrangement are reported in the statement of financial position
acceptedZhAnswers: 供应商融资负债的账面金额
acceptedEnVariants: carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities

examples.en: The note showed the carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities at the beginning and end of the period.
examples.zh: 附注列出了期初和期末的「供应商融资负债的账面金额」。

examples.en: We traced the carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities to the relevant line items in the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 我们在资产负债表上找到了与「供应商融资负债的账面金额」对应的项目。

collocations: disclose the carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities
calculate the carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities
reconcile the carrying amount of supplier finance liabilities
